main_text.head: LXV. JOHAN. CASIMIRI COM. PAL. AD LEGATUM RESP.

p.i: Johannes Casimirus comes Palatinus Reni, Tutor & Palatinatus Electoralis administrator, Dux Bavaria, &c.

main_text.p: REddidit nobis litteras tuas D. Callignonius fideliterque exposuit.
